## 2023 Honda CR-V EX-L Safety Features Overview
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/car-front.svg
The 2023 Honda CR-V EX-L trim offers a comprehensive suite of safety features, combining advanced passive restraints with the Honda Sensing® driver-assist technologies to enhance protection and driver awareness. It has also received top safety ratings from independent organizations.

### Core Safety Systems and Passive Protection
The CR-V EX-L is equipped with a robust set of passive safety features designed to protect occupants in the event of a collision.
- **Advanced Airbag System**: Includes 10 airbags, featuring front airbags, front knee airbags, front side airbags, rear side airbags, and side curtain airbags with rollover sensor.
- **Advanced Compatibility Engineering™ (ACE™) Body Structure**: Honda's proprietary body design enhances occupant protection and crash compatibility in frontal collisions.
- **Anti-lock Braking System (ABS)**: With Electronic Brake Distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist.
- **Vehicle Stability Assist™ (VSA®)**: With Traction Control.
- **Multi-Angle Rearview Camera**: With dynamic guidelines.

### Honda Sensing® Driver-Assist Technologies
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shield-fill-check.svg
The EX-L trim comes standard with the full Honda Sensing® suite, providing a range of active safety and driver-assistive features:
- **Collision Mitigation Braking System™ (CMBS™)**
- **Road Departure Mitigation System (RDM)**
- **Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC)** with Low-Speed Follow
- **Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS)**
- **Forward Collision Warning (FCW)**
- **Lane Departure Warning (LDW)**
- **Traffic Jam Assist**
- **Traffic Sign Recognition System (TSR)**
- **Blind Spot Information System (BSI)** with Cross Traffic Monitor
- **Auto High-Beam Headlights**
- **Front and Rear Parking Sensors**
- **Low-Speed Braking Control**

### Independent Crash Test Ratings
The 2023 Honda CR-V has earned high marks from leading independent safety organizations.

- **IIHS (Insurance Institute for Highway Safety)**:
  - **TOP SAFETY PICK+** (highest award for 2023)
  - Crashworthiness: Good (all categories including small overlap front, moderate overlap front, side, roof strength, head restraints & seats)
  - Headlights (EX-L trim): Good
  - Front crash prevention (vehicle-to-vehicle): Superior
  - Front crash prevention (vehicle-to-pedestrian, day): Superior

- **NHTSA (National Highway Traffic Safety Administration)**:
  - **5-Star Overall Safety Rating** (highest possible rating)
  - Overall Frontal Crash: 5 Stars
  - Frontal Barrier - Driver: 5 Stars
  - Frontal Barrier - Passenger: 5 Stars
  - Overall Side Crash: 5 Stars
  - Side Barrier: 5 Stars
  - Side Pole Crash: 5 Stars
  - Rollover: 4 Stars

### Quick Actions
- Get more details from Honda: [Button: 2023 CR-V Features](https://automobiles.honda.com/cr-v)
- View IIHS safety ratings: [Button: IIHS CR-V Ratings](https://www.iihs.org/ratings/vehicle/honda/cr-v-4-door-suv/2023)
- View NHTSA safety ratings: [Button: NHTSA CR-V Ratings](https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle/2023/HONDA/CR-V/SUV/FWD)
